mathematical_paraphrase: Every hom-set of a preadditive category has an abelian-group structure, and composition is additive separately in each variable.
context_caution: No general claim that a zero object or all kernels/cokernels exist; preadditive does not automatically imply additive.

mathematical_paraphrase: An additive category is a preadditive category with all finite products; equivalently it has a zero object and direct sums of finite collections of objects.
context_caution: Finite products including the empty product are required; additive categories need not have all kernels or cokernels.

mathematical_paraphrase: An abelian category is additive, admits kernels and cokernels of all its morphisms, and for each morphism the canonical map from coimage to image is an isomorphism.
context_caution: Existence of (co)kernels alone is insufficient: the canonical coimage-to-image isomorphism must also be required; do not assert that all additive categories are abelian.
